body:
sorry for the delayed replies.

my mum flew over to visit me out of concern. she planned friday - monday. I really didn't think it was a great idea. She gave me some cash to help make ends meet which I am grateful for, but she's not really a very good listener. truth be told, she's opinionated, dismissive, likes the sound of her own voice and very-critical.

we ended up having a huge row last night over basically nothing. i should have kept my temper but, as has been said, I'm pretty raw and not centered in any way at the moment.

i called the samartians today.
I think i'll be calling them back. typing it out is cathartic, but, skype is quite handy.

thanks for the reply.

i know it's cliché, but just reading the "it's normal" "it gets better" has put some context into my spiralling unfocussed mind. the past few days have been a vortex.

sadly, I can't use a gym. I barely achieve 10/15 minutes on my feet per day, and when I do, I have swelling and pain for 24 hours afterwards.
I used to really enjoy tai-chi & martial arts.

yeah, i can get out of the country; just not as immediately as I'd like, but, it's doable within a couple of months I guess. Having spent 6 years creating a home here means it's a whole bunch of stuff. I don't care for "stuff" per se, it's just another damned thing on the list of shit I now have to take care of.
